Characterization_methods: High-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM)
Proof in the paper: The platelet γ-Al2O3 (Figure 1c) has a lattice spacing of 0.28 nm corresponding to the (110) facet that can be observed on its surface. The tubular γ-Al2O3 (Figure 1g) is enclosed by the (111) facet, as evidenced by the lattice spacing of 0.46 nm. No obvious difference can be observed on the powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns, while there is a noteworthy difference at 2θ ∼19°, as shown in the inset of Figure 1d,h, we can see the peak on the sample of Al2O3-T, which is attributed to (111) facet, but it is not shown on Al2O3-P.
